column3: “Harbor” specifies the entrance; “Tyre” supplies the referent.
The statement that the traders filled the coastland is absent.
“Nile” identifies the River, and “Tyre” supplies the pronoun’s referent.
“Stronghold of the sea” is attached to Sidon rather than to the sea’s speech.
The pride of all splendor is condensed into glorious beauty.
“Cultivate” stands for passing through; “harbor” replaces the girdle or restraint.
